items.title: PM Narendra Modi Hails India Women's Hockey Team After Asian Games Gold Ends 44-Year Wait, Seals LA 2028 Berth

candidate_claims.text: Home Sports PM Narendra Modi Hails India Women's Hockey Team After Asian Games Gold Ends 44-Year Wait, Seals LA 2028 Berth PM Narendra Modi Hails India Women's Hockey Team After Asian Games Gold Ends 44-Year Wait, Seals LA 2028 Berth PM Narendra Modi congratulated India’s women’s hockey team after its 1-0 win over China secured Asian Games gold following a 44-year wait.
The victory also secured India a direct berth at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

IANS Updated: Friday, October 02, 2026, 09:12 PM IST PM Modi Hails India Women's Hockey Team After Asian Games Gold Ends 44-Year Wait, Seals LA 2028 Berth | X New Delhi, Oct 2: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday congratulated the Indian women's hockey team on winning a historic gold in the Asian Games 2026 in Nagoya, which ended a 44-year wait for the yellow metal for the country in the Continental extravaganza.
This 1-0 win over China in the final also sealed the Indian women's hockey team a direct berth in the Los Angeles Olympic Games in 2028.
The people of India are rejoicing in the success of the Women’s Hockey Team, who bring home the coveted Gold at the Asian Games and that too after over 4 decades.
